svg.title: Repo Context: load the instruction files a repo already has
svg.desc: RepoContext has three strategies. On by default, the walk-up loads AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md from the working directory and each ancestor up to home_dir into the instructions, broadest first, once per run. Off by default, the inventory_agent_context tool reports where the .claude, .agents, .codex and .grok roots keep skills, agents and hooks. Off by default, nested traversal reacts to FileSystem reading or listing a directory, such as src/api, and queues a pointer to that directory's AGENTS.md before the next model request.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
